title: Compat API v1.48: platform, GwPriority, build/prune, image mounts, and related gaps
body:
Docker Engine API [v1.48](https://docs.docker.com/reference/api/engine/version-history/#v148-api-changes) still has several Compat gaps before we can treat 1.48 as covered under the parent epic (claim v1.55).
## Needs work
### Platform selection
- [ ] `GET /images/{name}/history?platform=` (JSON-encoded OCI platform)
- [ ] `POST /images/load` and `GET /images/{name}/get` `platform` (single platform; multi-platform is tracked under v1.52)
### Networking
- [ ] Accept `GwPriority` on create/connect `EndpointsConfig`; return it on list/inspect endpoints
- [ ] Honor `EnableIPv4` on `POST /networks/create` (inspect currently hardcodes `true`; create ignores the field)
- [ ] eth0 HostConfig sysctl vs `DriverOpts` behavior (depends on v1.46 DriverOpts; do not migrate eth0 sysctls into DriverOpts)
### Containers / mounts / images
- [ ] `type=image` mount `ImageOptions.Subpath` for Compat create (basic `type=image` path exists; subpath is incomplete) - related #30041
- [ ] Populate `ImageManifestDescriptor` on `GET /containers/{name}/json` and `GET /containers/json` when a platform-specific manifest is known
### Build prune
- [ ] Implement `POST /build/prune` (endpoint missing today), including `reserved-space` (renamed from `keep-storage`), `max-used-space`, and `min-free-space`
## Contributing
If you want to work on one checklist item, please open a focused issue (or PR) for that part and reference **this** issue (and the parent epic). Prefer one change area per PR.
